data.action: 单臂肩抗巨型重火器第七圣典，神圣光辉汇聚炮口，眼神冷冽推了推眼镜架
data.camera: cowboy shot, low angle, heavy artillery combat view
data.description: 【希耶尔 · 第七圣典月下重炮制裁】废弃工业大楼顶端狂风呼啸，希耶尔身穿深蓝修女法衣战袍，戴着金丝无框眼镜。她单臂稳稳架起比人还庞大、散发着神圣白光的巨型概念武装「第七圣典」，炮口魔力洪流汇聚如炽热烈阳。短发在狂暴的气流中飞舞，镜片后深蓝眼眸冷静而决绝——「转生之因果，由我在此斩断。第七圣典，神圣真理击铁开合！」
data.lighting: 第七圣典炽烈白金炮口光芒与清冷夜色
data.location: 废弃工厂高耸水泥平台顶端
data.promptProse: Ciel braces the immense Seventh Scripture cannon with one arm on an abandoned industrial rooftop, her blue eyes steady behind rimless glasses. Her navy sleeveless clergy tunic, white accents and gold crosses remain visible below wind-tossed short hair. The low cowboy view places broken roof fixtures and distant buildings behind the weapon. Its white-gold muzzle light illuminates her glove and face, sharply separating them from the cooler night skyline.
data.title: 希耶尔 · 第七圣典月下重炮制裁
